greeting: Egameni likaYise, neloNyana, neloMoya oyiNgcwele. Makube noxolo lweNkosi yethu uYesu Kristu, uKumkani wethu, kunye nani nonke.
penitential: Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi. Kristu, ube nenceba kuthi. Nkosi, ube nenceba kuthi.
psalm_response: INkosi ingumalusi wam; akukho nto ndiyisweleyo.
homily:
Cinga ngomzuzu apho ubona umfana ehlala phantsi kwesibhakabhaka esikhulu, ejonge phezulu ngamehlo agcwele ukumangaliswa. UBenjamin Vo wayenalo olo hlobo lwembono. Wayengumfana owayethanda iinqwelo-moya, owayecinga nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe ngoncumo olungazenzisiyo, owayebona ihlabathi njengendawo ebanzi, ezele ngamathuba okufunda nokwakha. Wayenengqondo eqaqambileyo, kodwa ngaphezu koko, wayenentliziyo eyayihlala ivulekile. Khumbula indlela awayemomotheka ngayo xa wayethetha ngale nkampani yakhe ye-'con chim airlines'. Yayiyiphupha elincinci, kodwa yayithwele ukukhanya kweminyaka yakhe elishumi elinesihlanu.

KwiNcwadi kaHezekile namhlanje, uThixo uthi: 'Ndiya kuzikhangela izimvu zam, ndiziphengulule.' Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… Ndiya kuzikhangela. UThixo akahlali kude nentlungu yethu. Xa izimvu zisasazeke ebumnyameni, xa ikhaya liziva lingenanto, xa intliziyo yomzali iziva ngathi imnyama, uThixo ukhona. Uthi: 'Ilahlekileyo ndiya kuyikhangela, edukileyo ndiya kuyibuyisa.' UBen wayengumfana owayethanda ukwabelana, owayethanda ukuhleka xa ethetha nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe. Uthando lwakhe lwalungapheliyo, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhanya nangoku. UBen wayengumntwana wokukhanya.

KwiVangeli yanamhlanje, uYesu uthetha ngesahlulo sokugqibela. Uthi: 'Ngenani, nina basikelelweyo nguBawo.' Uthi kuye kwakukho indlala, kwakukho ukoma, kwakukho ukugula, kwaye abantu bamnceda. Masiyimele kancinci le ndinyana… 'Nani nenzela omnye waba bafowethu bam abancinane, nandinzela mna.' Le yimfihlelo yobomi: asikokuba unika malini, kodwa ukuba intliziyo yakho ikulungele na ukunika. Khumbula uBen xa wayefuna ukunikela ngayo yonke imali yakhe yasebhange ukuze ancede umalume wakhe uWilliam. Wayengazange ayiphule loo ngulube, kodwa isipho sasingaphakathi entliziyweni yakhe. UBen wayeyiqonda le nto. Wayengumfana owayethanda ukwabelana, owayethanda ukuhleka xa ethetha nge-'con chim airlines' yakhe, owayethanda ukuba noRyan ecaleni kwakhe.

Alan noThao, ndiyazi ukuba kule minyane mihlanu idlulileyo ukususela ngowe-13 kuJuni 2026, iintlungu ziza ngamanye amaxesha ngendlela embi kakhulu. Kukho amaxesha apho ukungabikho kukaBen kwenza ikhaya libe ngenye indlela. Kukho ukudinwa okungafani nokudinwa komzimba; kukudinwa komphefumlo. Mamele kakuhle, Alan noThao: uThixo akakubeki icala. UBen akakubeki icala. Ezo zifo aziziswanga zizinto owazenzayo okanye ongazenzanga. Kweli hlabathi, kukho izinto ezenzeka ngaphandle kolawulo lomntu, ngaphandle kwempazamo yomzali. Awuphosanga nto. Uthando lwakho lwalucocekile, lwaluphelele, kwaye uBen wayesazi ukuba unothando olungaka kubazali bakhe nakuRyan. Khipha elo litye lokuzisola ezintliziyweni zenu namhlanje. UBen akajongi iziphoso; ujonge phezulu kuThixo, kwaye uqhubeka esithi kuwe: 'Ba, Mama, musani ukukhala kakhulu, ndikhuselekile.'

Ryan, mfowethu okhoyo apha, ndifuna uthathe oku nawe. UBen akakushiye. Ukhona ecaleni kwakho, eqhubeka ekusebenza njengesikhokelo sothando. UBen wayengumfana owayenenqgondo enkulu yezibalo nolwazi, kodwa ikratshi lakhe elikhulu kwakuwukuba ngumntwana omhle owayehlonipha abazali bakhe. UBen uya kuhlala ekukhuthaza, nangona ungamboni ngamehlo, kodwa uya kumva entliziyweni yakho. Uthando lwenu njengabazalwana luyinto engunaphakade. Xa uziva usodwa, khumbula ukuba uBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. UBen akakho nje kwimbali yenu; ukwikhona apho uThixo enza khona yonke into ibe ntsha. UBen ngoku ungumntu okhululekileyo, ophilileyo, ojonge phezulu kuThixo ngoncumo olufanayo nolokuba wayesemncinci, xa wayesadlala neebhaluni zakhe phambi kwe-fireplace.

Masithathe oku namhlanje: uBen wasishiya isipho sothando olungapheliyo. Kwisikhumbuzo sesidlo sasezulwini, lapho indlu kaThixo izele khona ngabantu abavela kude nakufi, masime nathi namhlanje siqinisekile ukuba ubomi bukaBen abuphelanga ethuneni. Usemthekweni wasezulwini, apho i-'con chim airlines' yakhe ibhabha ngokuphakamileyo phambi kobuso bukaThixo. Hamba ke namhlanje uphumle, uthembe ukuba uThixo uyakuthanda, kwaye uBen ulinda wena ngoncumo lwakhe oluqhelekileyo. Uthando lwakho, Ben, lusaqhubeka luhamba emhlabeni, lusaqhubeka lukhanya, kwaye lusaqhubeka lukhumbuza wonke umntu okwaziyo ukuba uThixo uyamthanda umntwana wakhe ngaphezu kwayo yonke into. Hlalani neli themba. Hlalani nolu thando. UBen ukhona, uyaqhubeka, kwaye uya kuhlala ephila kuthando lukaThixo olungapheliyo. Amen.
spiritual_communion: Yesu wam, ndiyakholelwa ukuba ukhona kwiS Sacrament esiyiNgcwele. Ndiyakuthanda ngaphezu kwayo yonke into, kwaye ndinqwenela ukukwamkela emphefumlweni wam. Ekubeni ndingenakukwamkela ngoku ngokwasemzimbeni, nceda uze kum ngokomoya. Ndiyakwamkela njengokungathi sele ulapha, ndize ndizibophelele kuwe ngokupheleleyo. Ungaze undivumele ndahluke kuwe. Amen.
closing: INkosi mayisikelele, isigcine, kwaye isikhokelele kuxolo lwayo ngonaphakade. Amen.
standing_petitions: Sithandazela uBen kunye nabo bonke ababhubhileyo, ukuze baphumle ekukhanyeni kukaKristu ngonaphakade.
Sithandazela bonke abasemlilweni wokudabuka, ukuze uThixo abathuthuzele abanike ithemba.

readings.label: Isifundo sokuqala
readings.text: Utsho uYehova uThixo ukuthi: Nanko mna, ndiya kuzikhangela izimvu zam, ndiziphengulule. Njengokuba umalusi eziphengulula izimvu zakhe ngemini abakuyo phakathi kwezimvu zakhe ezichithakeleyo, ndiya kuziphengulula izimvu zam; ndiya kuzihlangula ezindaweni zonke ezithe zachithakelwa kuzo ngemini yelifu nobumnyama. Mna ndiya kuzalusa izimvu zam, mna ndiya kuzilalisa, utsho uYehova uThixo. Eilahlekileyo ndiya kuyikhangela, edukileyo ndiya kuyibuyisa, eyenzakeleyo ndiya kuyibopha, egulayo ndiya kuyomeleza; ke eityebileyo neyomeleleyo ndiya kuyitshabalalisa; ndiya kuzalusa ngokusesikweni. Ke nina, zimvu zam, utsho uYehova uThixo, nanko mna ndigweba phakathi kwemvu nemvu, phakathi kweenkunzi zeegusha neebhokhwe.

readings.label: INdumiso
readings.text: R. INkosi ingumalusi wam; akukho nto ndiyisweleyo. INkosi ingumalusi wam; andiyi kuswela nto. Emadlelweni aluhlaza indilalisa; ngasemanzini okuphumla indikhokela. R. INkosi ingumalusi wam; akukho nto ndiyisweleyo. Iwuvuselela umphefumlo wam; indikhokela ezindleleni zobulungisa ngenxa yegama layo. R. INkosi ingumalusi wam; akukho nto ndiyisweleyo. Undilungisele itafile phambi kwabazondi bam; intloko yam uyithambisa ngeoli, indebe yam iyaphuphuma. R. INkosi ingumalusi wam; akukho nto ndiyisweleyo. Inene, ububele nenceba ziya kundilandela yonke imihla yobomi bam; ndiya kuhlala endlwini yeNkosi imihla yonke yobomi bam. R. INkosi ingumalusi wam; akukho nto ndiyisweleyo.

readings.label: Isifundo sesibini
readings.text: Bazalwana: UKristu uvusiwe kwabafileyo, engumthwalo wokuqala wabaleleyo. Kuba ekubeni ukufa kwavela ngomntu, uvuko lwabafileyo lavela ngomntu. Kuba njengokuba bonke besifa kuAdam, ngokunjalo bonke baya kwenziwa badle ubomi kuKristu. Ke elowo ngomyalelo wakhe: uKristu engumthwalo wokuqala; emva koko abakaKristu, ekuzeni kwakhe. Emva koko isiphelo, xa ayinikelayo ukumkani kuThixo uYise, xa eyibhukuqileyo yonke inkosana, nalo lonke igunya, namandla onke. Kuba umelwe ukuba abekumkani, ade azibeke iintshaba zonke phantsi kweenyawo zakhe. Intshaba yokugqibela etshabalalayo kukufa. Xa ke zonke izinto zithe zathobela kuye, khona ke noNyana uya kuzithoba kuye owathobela zonke izinto kuye, ukuze uThixo abe zizinto zonke kubo bonke.

readings.label: IVangeli
readings.text: UYesu wathi kubafundi bakhe: Xa athe weza uNyana woMntu esebuqaqawulini bakhe, neengelosi zonke enaye, uya kuhlala etroneni yobuqaqawuli bakhe; ziya kuhlanganiselwa phambi kwakhe iintlanga zonke; uya kuzahlula, njengomalusi azahlulayo izimvu ezibhokhweni; azibeke izimvu ngasekunene kwakhe, iibhokhwe ke ngasekhohlo. Wothi ke uKumkani kwabangasekunene kwakhe, Yizani nina basikelelweyo nguBawo, nidle ilifa lobukumkani obulungiselelwe nina kwasekusekweni kwehlabathi. Kuba ndibe ndilambile, nandipha ndadla; ndibe ndinxaniwe, nandipha ndasela; ndibe ndingumphambukeli, nandingenisa; ndibe ndihamba ze, nandambesa; ndibe ndigula, nandindwendwela; ndibe ndisejele, neza niza kum. Baya kuphendula ke abalungileyo, besithi, Nkosi, sakubona nini ulambile, sa kupha wadla? okanye unxaniwe, sa kupha wasela? Sakubona nini ungumphambukeli, sa kungenisa? okanye uhamba ze, sa kwambesa? Sakubona nini ugula, okanye usejele, saza seza kuwe? Wophendula ke uKumkani, athi kubo, Inene, ndithi kuni, ngenxa yokuba nenzela omnye waba bafowethu bam abancinane, nandinzela mna. Wothi ke nakwabangasekhohlo, Sukani kum nina baqalekisiweyo, niye emlilweni ongunaphakade, obulungiselelwe uSathana neengelosi zakhe. Kuba ndibe ndilambile, anandipha ndadla; ndibe ndinxaniwe, anandipha ndasela; ndibe ndingumphambukeli, anandingenisa; ndibe ndihamba ze, anandambesa; ndibe ndigula, ndisejele, anandindwendwela. Baya kuphendula nabo, besithi, Nkosi, sakubona nini ulambile, okanye unxaniwe, okanye ungumphambukeli, okanye uhamba ze, okanye ugula, okanye usejele, singakukhonzanga? Wophendula ke athi kubo, Inene, ndithi kuni, ngenxa yokuba ningenzanga ngenye yaba bancinane, anandenzela mna. Baya kumka abo baye ekohlwayweni okungunaphakade; ke wona amalungisa aya ebomini obungunaphakade.

day: The Solemnity of Our Lord Jesus Christ, King of the Universe

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: I miss you so much Ben! Ba má nhớ con rất nhiều mỗi ngày.
Nha Trang, ngày 31/10/2026, anh Minh suy nghĩ về Ben rất nhiều. Nhớ và thương em!!!

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - mom and I have been missing you a lot.   Saw you a few times in my dreams last few weeks! Come and say hi daily okay?
Thinking of you buddy! Stop by to say hello whenever you can okay? Love you Ben

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Hey Ben - Been dreaming about you a lot. Hope you're having fun up in heaven. Please look after our family. Remember to come say hi daily. We miss you so much!

Ben ơi, trong giấc ngủ anh Huy đã thấy Ben về thăm anh, trao cho anh lời cầu nguyện để hai anh em mình lại được tìm thấy nhau. Xin Chúa thương nhậm lời Ben, cho Ben được hưởng ngàn thu bình an bên Chúa. Nếu có thể, xin Ben lại ghé thăm anh trong những giấc mơ tiếp theo nhé, dù chỉ là một lời chào hay một nụ cười thân thương như ngày nào.

pet_prayers.name: Dad
pet_prayers.text: Ben, my sweet boy, I miss you so much. Thank you for visiting me and Chú Chris last night. He told me he saw you flying a helicopter—so free, joyful, and strong up there. Down here, Mom and I are crying more and more each day. A piece of my heart feels completely dead without you, Ben. Please watch over us, pray for your mom, your brother Ryan, and me, and give us the strength to keep going. We love you forever
